title: Immutable approved versions
rule: An approved estimate version shall not be edited; changes require a new version.

title: Calculation trace required
rule: Every sell amount shall retain traceable quantity, rate, formula, factors and markup sources.

title: Tenant isolation
rule: No tenant may access another tenant’s estimates, pricing, actuals or configurations.

title: AI requires disposition
rule: Material AI recommendations shall be accepted, modified or rejected by an authorized user.

title: Unit compatibility
rule: Quantity and resource units shall be dimensionally compatible before calculation.

title: Effective-date pricing
rule: Pricing records shall be selected using estimate date and effective-date rules.

title: Quote precedence
rule: Approved project-specific quotes override regional and library prices for their scope.

title: Markup sequence
rule: Markup profiles shall define whether each component is additive, compounded or margin-targeted.

title: No hidden overrides
rule: Manual overrides shall require reason, author and timestamp.

title: Crew balance
rule: Crew output shall be constrained by the bottleneck resource unless an approved rule states otherwise.

title: Haul cycle completeness
rule: Truck calculations shall include load, travel, unload, return, queue and delay components.

title: Swell and shrink separation
rule: Bank, loose and compacted volumes shall not be treated as interchangeable.

title: Confidence propagation
rule: Estimate confidence shall consider source confidence, quantity confidence, rate confidence and risk.

title: Historical calibration approval
rule: Actual-based calibration shall not update master rates without review and approval.

title: Role-based visibility
rule: User workspaces shall expose only permitted modules, records and actions.

title: White-label inheritance
rule: OEM child tenants shall inherit allowed defaults while preserving approved local overrides.

title: Offline conflict handling
rule: Offline changes shall use deterministic conflict detection and review.

title: Currency consistency
rule: A single estimate version shall use one base currency with explicit conversion records when needed.

title: Tax jurisdiction
rule: Tax rules shall be selected from project jurisdiction and effective date.

title: Estimate lock
rule: Submitted estimates shall be locked from unapproved edits.

title: Source retention
rule: Referenced plans, quotes and attachments shall be retained according to policy.

title: Scenario isolation
rule: Scenario changes shall not alter the baseline estimate until promoted.

title: Rounding policy
rule: Rounding shall occur only at configured stages and retain unrounded calculation values.

title: Negative cost control
rule: Negative quantities or rates require an approved adjustment type.

title: Deletion policy
rule: Used master records shall be retired, not deleted.

title: Regional override priority
rule: Tenant and project overrides shall follow an explicit precedence hierarchy.

title: Production factor bounds
rule: Condition factors outside configured bounds require approval.

title: Fuel model selection
rule: Equipment fuel may use measured, manufacturer, historical or formula sources with source type recorded.

title: Bid audit export
rule: The system shall produce a review package containing assumptions, exceptions and calculation lineage.

title: Template governance
rule: Published templates require version, owner and approval status.
